notes: Sports leads — a five-minute scored soccer match with goals, teams and a real-looking stadium — with Party & Casual named second for the lobby of mode boxes, which is where social-hub and the lobby-to-stage teleporters come from. I took space-staged rather than Sports' usual bounded field, a shape from outside the genre's typical list, because the answers make the lobby a separate place that teleports players into the match, and that is precisely a match area fully isolated from the staging area; the shape carries P4, and here the prompt settles the judgement in favour of separate maps rather than leaving it silent, so I kept it. Worth flagging for the pipeline that P4 is not running yet, so this is the one build in the batch that cannot ship today as described — folding the lobby into the pitch surface would return it to P0 if that trade is acceptable. The requested crowds land on ambient population, and the tiered seating is what adds the tiered flag. Deciding without a user: one arcade-sized pitch shared by every mode from 1v1 to 5v5 instead of five separate grounds, and no interiors, so the P4 covers only the lobby-and-stage split; controls, platform support, camera and the human-or-AI goalkeeper choice are gameplay with no layout footprint.
